evidence_required: The matrix; a written justification (one sentence) for each role's two highest-rated and two lowest-rated domains; a gap list with chapter and artifact for each gap.

marking.criterion: At least 12 skill domains rated 0-3 for the three named roles, consistent with Table 1.10 within plus or minus 1 per cell
One-sentence justification for each role's two highest and two lowest domains
Personal column present and every gap of 2 or more mapped to a specific chapter
Each gap names a concrete artifact (lab output, script, design doc)

title: Role-to-skill matrix
